findings.title: Returned initiation errors can consume the abort slot
findings.detail: A joined explicit error with no receipt leaves graceful mode. Its graceful replacement consumes the second control call; a held request can then prevent abort escalation at the owner deadline. Missing-result recovery alone does not satisfy the contract.
findings.required_repair: Treat returned initiation errors without a receipt as uncertainty and use the single replacement in abort mode. Add a held-request regression proving cancellation, original completion, both helper joins, public transport and creator joins, and no third call.
